justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: NICU therapy outcomes (feeding, positioning, development) supported; NTCB certification-specific comparative studies absent.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: National exam plus 3 years experience and continuing education requirements; moderate cost.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable only in NICU settings; very narrow patient population scope.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: NICU therapy billed as OT/PT; specialty certification supports neonatal program documentation and payer authorization.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Valued in NICU therapy positions; moderate demand in academic medical centers with established NICU programs.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Family satisfaction with specialized NICU team is high; parental education component valued.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: NICU work is hospital-based; no meaningful cash-pay market.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: CNT is uncommon but only matters within hospital employers.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Not applicable to a private-practice owner model.
justifications.business.efficiency: CNT requires 3,500+ NICU hours plus exam; slow accumulation.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Respected credential for neonatal faculty/clinical-educator roles.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Solid neonatal therapy literature; less methodologically dense than NIDCAP.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Strong fit for NICU content in peds curricula.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Reasonable evidence base spanning feeding, positioning, and developmental care.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Preferred for neonatal-focused faculty positions, which are limited.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Long clinical-hour requirement, but exam itself is efficient.
